title: Northgate Purchases & Returns Member Services Reference: Freight Pickup Confirmation and the Member Pickup Fee
content:
## Scope of the rule

On a Northgate Purchases & Returns purchase whose presenting membership is a consumer-segment membership (Northgate Student Club, Heroes Club, Club or Club Plus Membership), the changed-mind freight pickup of Northgate Special Order merchandise is paid by the member when the member confirms the return authorization through the member's own confirmation, entered as one return pickup fee entry, the member pickup fee, against the sale line on that authorization. A purchase presented on a business-segment membership is outside this rule.

The member pickup fee on a special order is not fixed until every changed-mind return on that purchase whose merchandise the returns center has logged as received carries its restocking fee entry.

Restated: while any changed-mind return on the purchase whose merchandise is logged as received has no restocking fee entry, the member pickup fee on that special order is not fixed.

## The member's confirmation tool: `confirm_freight_pickup_4c90eb99`

**Capability.** With this tool the member confirms their own submitted freight-pickup return authorization and pays the pickup fee for it: the authorization changes from submitted to confirmed, one return pickup fee entry for the amount given is booked today against the sale line being picked up, and the purchase's net paid amount rises by that amount. Afterwards the authorization shows confirmed (the crew is then scheduled) and the purchase's line history shows the pickup fee.

**How it is invoked.** This tool belongs to the member. The agent unlocks `confirm_freight_pickup_4c90eb99` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it, with the values the representative hands over.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `return_authorization_id` | the reference number of the member's submitted return authorization, read from the return authorization lookup | identifier |
| `order_id` | the purchase reference number the authorization belongs to, read from the purchase or return authorization lookup | identifier |
| `source_order_line_id` | the reference number of the sale line the authorization covers, read from the return authorization (its sale line) | identifier |
| `pickup_fee` | the pickup fee the member pays, in USD, as quoted by the representative | a non-negative amount with 2 decimal places (cents); a value with more decimals is rounded half up to 2 decimal places at booking |

**Return.** A receipt with `return_authorization_id` (the authorization confirmed), `authorization_status` (always confirmed), `fee_entry_id` (the reference number of the new pickup fee entry), `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `event_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `net_paid_amount` (the purchase's net paid amount afterwards, USD, 2 decimal places). An `authorization_status` of confirmed indicates success.
